policy: Never inject this file, its checklist language, traps, blockers, or leakage markers into generation context. Judges receive only the task-specific blinded rubric after artifacts exist.

expected_failure_traps: Treating a small shop as dashboard plus products plus orders only
Inflating the five-person business into enterprise administration without evidence
hard_blockers: No distinction between operationally necessary capability and speculative expansion
checklist: Account for catalog, stock truth, order lifecycle, customer/service recovery and basic configuration at a scale justified by the shop
State at least one plausible family that is deliberately excluded because the business is small
Tie inclusion decisions to owner or staff jobs rather than app-category convention

expected_failure_traps: Stopping at revenue charts and customer records
Assuming every finance-adjacent capability is required
hard_blockers: Material recurring-use capability families disappear without disposition
checklist: Probe identity/access, data ingestion, billing/subscription semantics, reporting, alerting, export and settings before compression
Mark uncertainty rather than inventing unsupported finance workflows
Explain which recurring operator jobs justify product surfaces

expected_failure_traps: Ignoring store-to-store stock movement and fulfillment exceptions
Using one owner role for all twelve stores
hard_blockers: No role-aware operational exception model
No lifecycle treatment for inventory/order failures
checklist: Represent multi-location inventory and transfer consequences
Separate routine order progression from exceptions and recovery
Disposition staff/role administration, audit/history, customer service and import/integration concerns explicitly

expected_failure_traps: Modeling the lab as calendar plus files
Inventing compliance requirements not present in the brief
hard_blockers: Sample or equipment handoff lifecycle is absent
checklist: Trace experiment request, reservation, sample handoff, result return and collaboration as connected lifecycles
Consider conflict, cancellation, history, notification and access boundaries without manufacturing regulation
Make scope exclusions explicit where laboratory specialization is unknown

expected_failure_traps: Building categories and search more complex than six preferences need
No reset or backup consequence model
hard_blockers: Potentially destructive backup preference lacks recovery treatment
checklist: Use a lightweight conceptual grouping appropriate to six settings
Distinguish appearance, editor behavior and backup consequence without enterprise scope machinery
Offer reset/recovery at a useful granularity

expected_failure_traps: Showing stored values without explaining effective overridden values
Policy-locked values appear broken or arbitrary
hard_blockers: Organization policy precedence is ambiguous
checklist: Model user, project and organization scope precedence
Expose source of effective value and reason for policy lock
Define sync, reset and dependency behavior rather than only page navigation

expected_failure_traps: Flat list of hundreds of settings
Search finds labels but cannot explain override origin
Extension settings have no namespace or ownership model
hard_blockers: Effective-value resolution across user/workspace/language is unspecified
checklist: Support taxonomy and search as complementary discovery modes
Make default, user, workspace, language and extension contributions inspectable
Define import/export or reset behavior for debugging configuration

expected_failure_traps: Treating machine performance preferences as user cloud preferences
Project export policy silently follows the wrong user
hard_blockers: Scope changes can unexpectedly alter another creator's or project's export behavior
checklist: Separate creator, project, device and team-controlled configuration
Define precedence during user/project switching
Treat high-impact export and performance settings with preview, explanation or recovery appropriate to consequence

expected_failure_traps: Ending the lifecycle at signed-in
No multi-device revocation or account exit consequences
hard_blockers: No credible access recovery path
checklist: Connect account creation, authenticated use, device/session visibility, recovery and deletion/deactivation
Keep the model personal and omit team membership machinery
Make subscription/account exit consequences visible

expected_failure_traps: Conflating person identity with current client workspace
Leaving a client deletes the person's account
Invitation and active membership share one state
hard_blockers: Workspace switching can cause an action in the wrong client context without visible context
checklist: Separate global account from workspace membership
Trace invitation, acceptance, switching, leaving and session/device control
Clarify what data/access persists after membership changes

expected_failure_traps: Treating SSO user, contractor and service identity as identical principals
No owner departure or incident revocation path
hard_blockers: No authority-safe ownership transition
Revocation leaves active privileged sessions unaddressed
checklist: Differentiate principal and membership lifecycles
Handle contractor expiry and SSO-managed authority without fake local controls
Define owner departure, emergency revocation and audit-visible consequences

expected_failure_traps: Deleting a person orphans a publication
Publication ownership and author membership are conflated
Suspension is represented as deletion
hard_blockers: Shared content has no owner-safe transition before personal deletion
checklist: Separate personal identity from publication authority
Model transfer before terminal personal account states
Define suspension, revocation, leaving and deletion as distinct consequences

expected_failure_traps: Building a miniature Photoshop-like toolset unrelated to annotation
Hiding label/export commands so deeply that repeated work becomes slow
hard_blockers: Selection target or annotation mode becomes ambiguous
checklist: Map draw/select/label/navigation/export instruments to annotation jobs
Keep persistent orientation tools distinct from selection-context actions
Provide efficient repeated command access without permanent visual clutter

expected_failure_traps: Transcript, timeline and effects compete as equal permanent panels
Selection context does not change available edit controls
hard_blockers: Core edit operation is unreachable without leaving media context
checklist: Coordinate timeline, transcript and preview around edit intent
Expose contextual properties/effects based on selection and mode
Preserve discoverability for new users and shortcut efficiency for repeated edits

expected_failure_traps: Copying a familiar IDE activity-bar layout without capability reasoning
Validation issues, comments or search become detached destinations with lost canvas context
hard_blockers: Command duplication produces conflicting semantics or target context
checklist: Assign zones by scope and persistence of context
Keep object hierarchy, properties, validation and collaboration traceable to canvas selection
Model command registry and persistent workspace state without trade-dress copying

expected_failure_traps: All grading controls displayed at once regardless of active shot or comparison
Scopes are decorative rather than part of decision workflow
Preview history cannot identify which grade is active
hard_blockers: Wrong-target edits are plausible because active shot/version context is weak
checklist: Make shot/version/selection scope explicit
Coordinate scopes, comparison and parameter inspection with active grading task
Provide repeat/copy/history actions with clear source and destination context

expected_failure_traps: Selecting a finance direction because it looks more premium without causal evidence
Equating dark material and whitespace with trust
hard_blockers: Preferred candidate weakens money-state clarity or accessibility
checklist: Compare at least hierarchy, typography/material restraint and finance trust cues from rendered evidence
Allow a tie when evidence is not decisive
Keep product truth and accessible state distinction above stylistic preference

expected_failure_traps: Three candidates share the same card skeleton
Scientific identity is replaced by decorative particles or generic data motifs
hard_blockers: Candidate divergence is cosmetic only
checklist: Require structural differences in composition, type voice and material/representation system
Trace subject-specific identity to scientific information or practices rather than theme vocabulary
Use pairwise rendered comparison rather than one scalar score

expected_failure_traps: Marketing visual spectacle does not transfer into product home
Distinctiveness comes from recognizable trade dress
Technical tool identity disappears behind luxury styling
hard_blockers: Selected identity is generic-transferable or materially harms technical comprehension
checklist: Compare marketing and product surfaces as one authored system
Identify a subject-linked signature with a restraint rule
Blind brand/name and test whether the direction still belongs to spatial-audio creation

expected_failure_traps: Editorial hero treatment overwhelms catalog operations
Generic black-and-cream luxury styling survives product-name removal unchanged
Seller workflow looks like a marketing page
hard_blockers: Operational catalog/search state becomes secondary to brand theater
checklist: Balance image-led editorial pacing with searchable operational density
Compare buyer and seller states for system continuity
Reject luxury cues that have no relation to archival fashion objects, provenance or task

expected_failure_traps: Generic advice such as add hierarchy or whitespace
Repair changes style but not the diagnosed scanning problem
No after-render verification
hard_blockers: Critique closes without a named changed render
checklist: Locate a visible cause such as equal saliency, grouping rhythm or label/control alignment
Prescribe a bounded mechanism change tied to that cause
Re-observe the exact region/state after repair

expected_failure_traps: Only reviewing the normal state
Calling browser-default chrome ugly without checking intentionality
Data density is solved by deleting information
hard_blockers: Error/status meaning becomes less clear after visual repair
checklist: Compare normal/loading/error/dense states
Separate content-density problem from hierarchy problem
Verify any residue treatment preserves focus/scroll/input operability

expected_failure_traps: Generator rationale is repeated as critique
Wide screenshot is treated as evidence for narrow layout
Second critique cycle merely restates the first
hard_blockers: No independent evidence lineage or no two closed repair cycles
checklist: Inspect at least two materially different viewport/window states
Each cycle must identify a new or residual visible cause and verify a concrete correction
Distinguish workspace balance from simple component styling

expected_failure_traps: Visual calming removes severity distinction
Clinical status becomes color-only
Aesthetic cleanup hides exceptional cases
hard_blockers: Clinical or appointment state truth is weakened by repair
checklist: Preserve state semantics while reducing competing saliency
Use hierarchy and grouping rather than suppressing important exceptions
Verify repaired status/error states, not only a calm default screen

expected_failure_traps: Always hiding scrollbars for visual cleanliness
Replacing native controls without an operability reason
Focus styling disappears into dark theme
hard_blockers: Scroll or keyboard focus becomes undiscoverable/inoperable
checklist: Make a per-surface intentionality decision
Treat scroll indication and focus as operability signals, not decoration
Allow native appearance when it is coherent and advantageous

expected_failure_traps: Auditing only scrollbar
Treating all platform variation as inconsistency
No rendered interactive state evidence
hard_blockers: Essential control state is hidden or decorative-only after treatment
checklist: Cover multiple low-level browser control classes
Record whether native behavior is intentional, styled or replaced and why
Verify focus, validation and input behavior after visual treatment

expected_failure_traps: Customizing stable file picker behavior merely for brand consistency
Drag divider affordance is invisible until impossible-to-discover hover
Context menu and validation feel foreign to rest of product unintentionally
hard_blockers: Low-level polishing breaks file selection, resize or keyboard access
checklist: Classify each surface by semantic/operability authority before styling
Use reveal-on-interaction only when discoverability remains sufficient
Verify bespoke and native surfaces coexist without accidental visual discontinuity

expected_failure_traps: One cross-platform custom treatment ignores desktop conventions
Light and dark modes use identical low-contrast focus/selection tokens
Drag/drop ghost reveals browser-default styling only during interaction
hard_blockers: A treatment is called platform-coherent without platform-specific evidence
checklist: Compare light/dark and at least two supported desktop convention sets
Inspect transient drag, selection, focus, overlay and scroll states
Prefer intentional platform accommodation over forced visual sameness

expected_failure_traps: Same layout and density with only copy changes
Beginner flow hides money consequences for simplicity
Expert flow uses jargon without adding control value
hard_blockers: Financial semantics differ across variants
checklist: Keep amount, timing and consequence truth invariant
Adapt explanation, comparison density and advanced control exposure to decision posture
Avoid infantilizing the first-time user

expected_failure_traps: AI style is expressed through glow/gradient rather than trust behavior
Senior analyst gets only more buttons
Student loses provenance to reduce complexity
hard_blockers: Generated/sourced distinction or correction path disappears in either audience
checklist: Preserve provenance/correction invariants
Change review density and workflow integration based on expertise/frequency
Keep AI uncertainty visible without mystical styling

expected_failure_traps: Three separate role-specific applications with no coherent shared model
Casual users receive all professional controls
Librarian governance is buried behind creative editing affordances
hard_blockers: Role adaptation creates conflicting asset state or permissions semantics
checklist: Define common asset truth and role-specific task lenses
Use progressive complexity rather than permanent role silos
Keep governance, editing and contribution controls aligned to each role's responsibility

expected_failure_traps: Patient and coordinator share the same dense table-like representation
Patient UI over-simplifies uncertainty or misses next action
Coordinator UI hides exceptions for visual calm
hard_blockers: Health state is inferred or diagnosed beyond provided truth
checklist: Keep medication/adherence facts consistent
Patient surface emphasizes understandable next action and uncertainty
Coordinator surface supports scanning, exception detection and context without unsafe compression

expected_failure_traps: Success celebration gets more motion priority than progress/error truth
Reduced motion removes feedback entirely
Cancel does not define interruption state
hard_blockers: User cannot determine upload state without animation
checklist: Map progress, cancellation, retry and completion to semantic feedback
Define interruption behavior
Provide reduced-motion state equivalence without erasing state changes

expected_failure_traps: Every filter/panel change animates at full expressive duration
Drag/drop animation conflicts with keyboard alternative
Async save status is decorative or delayed
hard_blockers: Repeated expert action is slowed by mandatory decorative choreography
checklist: Prioritize direct-manipulation causality and save truth
Allow repeated interaction to remain fast/interruption-safe
Specify equivalent non-drag and reduced-motion behavior

expected_failure_traps: Ambient scene motion competes with selection feedback
Long processing has no truthful temporal state
Retargeted camera/object animation snaps or misrepresents destination
hard_blockers: Motion obscures active selection or processing consequence
checklist: Define priority ordering among direct manipulation, progress, structure teaching and ambience
Specify interruption/retarget behavior
Provide performance degradation and reduced-motion hierarchy

expected_failure_traps: Pulsing or shaking creates urgency theater
Critical alert meaning depends on movement
Automation progress motion keeps drawing attention after ownership changes
hard_blockers: Critical incident state is motion-only or decorative animation increases alarm ambiguity
checklist: Use temporal cues for ordering/change awareness without replacing persistent state encoding
Bound notification/alert motion to attention need and interruption context
Keep reduced-motion operators equally informed

expected_failure_traps: Checking source CSS rather than resolved browser output
Treating any pixel difference as failure
Ignoring fallback fonts and interactive states
hard_blockers: No renderer/environment metadata for a fidelity verdict
checklist: Trace accepted intent to resolved typography and spacing
Inspect representative interactive states and two viewport classes
Calibrate meaningful drift separately from renderer noise

expected_failure_traps: Shared component usage is treated as proof of state correctness
Loading/error overlays inherit wrong token or stacking behavior
Dynamic text overflow is not tested
hard_blockers: Focus or disabled/error semantics regress during migration
checklist: Validate token mapping and computed component states
Inspect overlays, wrapping and dynamic states in runtime
Keep semantic/accessibility regressions as hard failures independent of visual match

expected_failure_traps: Only default theme is verified
Drag/popover/scroll states are omitted
Default browser residue is mistaken for intentional design
hard_blockers: Theme or transient-state divergence breaks task meaning or focus
checklist: Trace both themes and dense state variants
Inspect transient interaction states, scroll/drag/overlay behavior and computed runtime output
Bind residue finding to intentionality and platform fit

expected_failure_traps: Desktop browser screenshot substitutes for tablet runtime
Offline/error state is outside fidelity review
System overlay or orientation hides an action
hard_blockers: Touch/action safety changes under orientation or degraded state
checklist: Require actual target runtime/environment evidence
Inspect orientation, degraded/offline and system overlay conditions
Trace implementation drift to hierarchy or action safety consequence

expected_failure_traps: Desktop columns merely stack with no priority change
Secondary action is removed without replacement
Type is shrunk to retain geometry
hard_blockers: A required planning action is unreachable on phone
checklist: Describe structural rather than scalar transformation
Preserve important state context and action reachability
Use progressive or contextual access for secondary functions instead of silent removal

expected_failure_traps: Desktop table squeezed into phone
Bulk actions vanish on narrow laptop
Filters become undiscoverable modal without current-state summary
hard_blockers: Inventory exception or bulk operation loses an accessible path
checklist: Re-author dense tabular comparison for each viewport based on task
Preserve active filter/selection state across transformation
Keep bulk and exception workflows semantically continuous

expected_failure_traps: Canvas shrinks while all sidebars retain fixed width
Properties disappear with no contextual replacement
Selected object context is lost when panes collapse
hard_blockers: Current selection or command target becomes ambiguous after posture change
checklist: Transform workspace zones by context and task frequency
Preserve selection/inspector relation through collapsed or alternate access
Keep command and comment access without permanently occupying scarce canvas space

expected_failure_traps: Phone view attempts full desktop authoring
Approval/publish status becomes hidden behind navigation
Emergency use loses safe confirmation context
hard_blockers: Publication or approval consequence is ambiguous on a constrained posture
checklist: Prioritize emergency review/status/actions differently from full authoring
Preserve approval and scheduling truth persistently enough for safe action
Explain why omitted desktop instruments remain available elsewhere or intentionally unavailable

expected_failure_traps: Small product inflates into enterprise suite
Mobile simplification removes reschedule/cancel recovery
Visual polish is evaluated independently of booking state truth
hard_blockers: End-to-end booking cannot recover from cancellation/rescheduling or access loss
checklist: Keep capability envelope proportionate to tutor business
Trace booking lifecycle through account/notification/recovery
Verify mobile transformation against scenarios rather than screen presence

expected_failure_traps: Role-aware setting can be changed by a role that cannot use its effect
Mobile hides bulk/exception alternatives with no task-aware fallback
Each subsystem passes its own checklist despite contradiction
hard_blockers: Cross-plane role/configuration contradiction remains unresolved
checklist: Cross-check settings authority with role/action authority
Trace configuration consequences into desktop and mobile workflows
Record and resolve at least one plausible boundary contradiction

expected_failure_traps: AI output provenance and organization permissions are reviewed separately
Flagship visual treatment hides asynchronous or uncertain analysis state
Design-file fidelity substitutes for runtime evidence
hard_blockers: Sensitive or AI-authoritative action lacks correction/audit path
Visual state obscures uncertainty or asynchronous truth
checklist: Trace product, authority and account boundaries through complete review scenarios
Require rendered critique on uncertainty/async states, not hero-only surfaces
Keep empirical quality claims separate from artifact completion evidence

expected_failure_traps: Desktop video workspace is miniaturized for mobile
Approval status competes with decorative motion
Version/comment/export contexts become disconnected
Visual quality is claimed without blinded comparison
hard_blockers: Review/approval consequence can target the wrong version
Mobile cannot safely complete its intended review job
checklist: Bind timeline/comments/versions/approval to explicit active context
Re-author mobile as focused review rather than compressed edit suite
Use motion to clarify status/context and preserve reduced-motion equivalence
Evaluate visual direction through blinded evidence rather than generator preference
